title: [mime-tree] Improve doc comments and examples
description:
Skoll findings for docs/comments in mime-tree:
- LOW-4: Document the 1024/256 preview split (1024 bytes covers worst-case 4-byte UTF-8 * 256 chars)
- LOW-9: Document that charset=None means 'no explicit charset param' vs RFC 2045 us-ascii default
- INFO-11: Document that per-part headers are accessible via header_range + parse_header_typed
- INFO-19: Expand find_by_id doc-comment to show both non-multipart (root='1') and multipart (root='') cases
- INFO-21: Add assert_eq!(msg.html_body, vec!['1']) to lib.rs doc-example
- LOW-15: Document in InlineYEncBlock that specific yenc error type is not exposed
- LOW-18: Document that ParsedHeader.value is decoded for text headers but raw for structured headers
- INFO-17: Document why InvalidRange uses u64 for available vs u32 offset/length
- MEDIUM-5: Add comment explaining .max(1) in find_ybegin for forward progress guarantee
close_reason: All 9 doc items addressed: LOW-4, LOW-9, INFO-11, INFO-19, INFO-21, LOW-15, LOW-18, INFO-17, MEDIUM-5
